name: Analytics Tag
description: Injects a third-party analytics tag site-wide (Google Analytics 4, Plausible or Matomo) with optional cookie-consent gating: when the cookie-consent plugin is active, tracking waits until the visitor accepts cookies.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read the analytics configuration (provider, tag ids, consent mode).
Save the analytics configuration from the admin page.
Expose the public config endpoint the loader script reads, plus the admin config endpoints.
Add the Analytics entry to the admin sidebar.
Enqueue the public loader script that injects the configured analytics tag on every public page.
